name: vistaplatform-monorepo
description: Vista Platform monorepo root. Declares npm workspaces for the shared TypeScript packages (api/ contract, packages/*) and the two frontends (frontend-v2, admin-ui-v2). The Go services live under services/ and use go.work for their workspace. See CLAUDE.md ('TypeScript / npm Workspaces') and docsv4/internal/developer/design/frontend-v2/adr/0005-monorepo-workspace-layout.md.
